blocks.source: Canto VI
blocks.translation: Canto VI

blocks.source: Al tornar de la mente, che si chiuse
blocks.translation: At the return of consciousness, that closed

blocks.source: dinanzi a la pietà d’i due cognati,
blocks.translation: Before the pity of those two relations,

blocks.source: che di trestizia tutto mi confuse,
blocks.translation: Which utterly with sadness had confused me,

blocks.source: novi tormenti e novi tormentati
blocks.translation: New torments I behold, and new tormented

blocks.source: mi veggio intorno, come ch’io mi mova
blocks.translation: Around me, whichsoever way I move,

blocks.source: e ch’io mi volga, e come che io guati.
blocks.translation: And whichsoever way I turn, and gaze.

blocks.source: Io sono al terzo cerchio, de la piova
blocks.translation: In the third circle am I of the rain

blocks.source: etterna, maladetta, fredda e greve;
blocks.translation: Eternal, maledict, and cold, and heavy;

blocks.source: regola e qualità mai non l’è nova.
blocks.translation: Its law and quality are never new.

blocks.source: Grandine grossa, acqua tinta e neve
blocks.translation: Huge hail, and water sombre-hued, and snow,

blocks.source: per l’aere tenebroso si riversa;
blocks.translation: Athwart the tenebrous air pour down amain;

blocks.source: pute la terra che questo riceve.
blocks.translation: Noisome the earth is, that receiveth this.

blocks.source: Cerbero, fiera crudele e diversa,
blocks.translation: Cerberus, monster cruel and uncouth,

blocks.source: con tre gole caninamente latra
blocks.translation: With his three gullets like a dog is barking

blocks.source: sovra la gente che quivi è sommersa.
blocks.translation: Over the people that are there submerged.

blocks.source: Li occhi ha vermigli, la barba unta e atra,
blocks.translation: Red eyes he has, and unctuous beard and black,

blocks.source: e ’l ventre largo, e unghiate le mani;
blocks.translation: And belly large, and armed with claws his hands;

blocks.source: graffia li spirti ed iscoia ed isquatra.
blocks.translation: He rends the spirits, flays, and quarters them.

blocks.source: Urlar li fa la pioggia come cani;
blocks.translation: Howl the rain maketh them like unto dogs;

blocks.source: de l’un de’ lati fanno a l’altro schermo;
blocks.translation: One side they make a shelter for the other;

blocks.source: volgonsi spesso i miseri profani.
blocks.translation: Oft turn themselves the wretched reprobates.

blocks.source: Quando ci scorse Cerbero, il gran vermo,
blocks.translation: When Cerberus perceived us, the great worm!

blocks.source: le bocche aperse e mostrocci le sanne;
blocks.translation: His mouths he opened, and displayed his tusks;

blocks.source: non avea membro che tenesse fermo.
blocks.translation: Not a limb had he that was motionless.

blocks.source: E ’l duca mio distese le sue spanne,
blocks.translation: And my Conductor, with his spans extended,

blocks.source: prese la terra, e con piene le pugna
blocks.translation: Took of the earth, and with his fists well filled,

blocks.source: la gittò dentro a le bramose canne.
blocks.translation: He threw it into those rapacious gullets.

blocks.source: Qual è quel cane ch’abbaiando agogna,
blocks.translation: Such as that dog is, who by barking craves,

blocks.source: e si racqueta poi che ’l pasto morde,
blocks.translation: And quiet grows soon as his food he gnaws,

blocks.source: ché solo a divorarlo intende e pugna,
blocks.translation: For to devour it he but thinks and struggles,

blocks.source: cotai si fecer quelle facce lorde
blocks.translation: The like became those muzzles filth-begrimed

blocks.source: de lo demonio Cerbero, che ’ntrona
blocks.translation: Of Cerberus the demon, who so thunders

blocks.source: l’anime sì, ch’esser vorrebber sorde.
blocks.translation: Over the souls that they would fain be deaf.

blocks.source: Noi passavam su per l’ombre che adona
blocks.translation: We passed across the shadows, which subdues

blocks.source: la greve pioggia, e ponavam le piante
blocks.translation: The heavy rain-storm, and we placed our feet

blocks.source: sovra lor vanità che par persona.
blocks.translation: Upon their vanity that person seems.

blocks.source: Elle giacean per terra tutte quante,
blocks.translation: They all were lying prone upon the earth,

blocks.source: fuor d’una ch’a seder si levò, ratto
blocks.translation: Excepting one, who sat upright as soon

blocks.source: ch’ella ci vide passarsi davante.
blocks.translation: As he beheld us passing on before him.

blocks.source: «O tu che se’ per questo ’nferno tratto»,
blocks.translation: “O thou that art conducted through this Hell,”

blocks.source: mi disse, «riconoscimi, se sai:
blocks.translation: He said to me, “recall me, if thou canst;

blocks.source: tu fosti, prima ch’io disfatto, fatto».
blocks.translation: Thyself wast made before I was unmade.”

blocks.source: E io a lui: «L’angoscia che tu hai
blocks.translation: And I to him: “The anguish which thou hast

blocks.source: forse ti tira fuor de la mia mente,
blocks.translation: Perhaps doth draw thee out of my remembrance,

blocks.source: sì che non par ch’i’ ti vedessi mai.
blocks.translation: So that it seems not I have ever seen thee.

blocks.source: Ma dimmi chi tu se’ che ’n sì dolente
blocks.translation: But tell me who thou art, that in so doleful

blocks.source: loco se’ messo, e hai sì fatta pena,
blocks.translation: A place art put, and in such punishment,

blocks.source: che, s’altra è maggio, nulla è sì spiacente».
blocks.translation: If some are greater, none is so displeasing.”

blocks.source: Ed elli a me: «La tua città, ch’è piena
blocks.translation: And he to me: “Thy city, which is full

blocks.source: d’invidia sì che già trabocca il sacco,
blocks.translation: Of envy so that now the sack runs over,

blocks.source: seco mi tenne in la vita serena.
blocks.translation: Held me within it in the life serene.

blocks.source: Voi cittadini mi chiamaste Ciacco:
blocks.translation: You citizens were wont to call me Ciacco;

blocks.source: per la dannosa colpa de la gola,
blocks.translation: For the pernicious sin of gluttony

blocks.source: come tu vedi, a la pioggia mi fiacco.
blocks.translation: I, as thou seest, am battered by this rain.

blocks.source: E io anima trista non son sola,
blocks.translation: And I, sad soul, am not the only one,

blocks.source: ché tutte queste a simil pena stanno
blocks.translation: For all these suffer the like penalty

blocks.source: per simil colpa». E più non fé parola.
blocks.translation: For the like sin;” and word no more spake he.

blocks.source: Io li rispuosi: «Ciacco, il tuo affanno
blocks.translation: I answered him: “Ciacco, thy wretchedness

blocks.source: mi pesa sì, ch’a lagrimar mi ’nvita;
blocks.translation: Weighs on me so that it to weep invites me;

blocks.source: ma dimmi, se tu sai, a che verranno
blocks.translation: But tell me, if thou knowest, to what shall come

blocks.source: li cittadin de la città partita;
blocks.translation: The citizens of the divided city;

blocks.source: s’alcun v’è giusto; e dimmi la cagione
blocks.translation: If any there be just; and the occasion

blocks.source: per che l’ha tanta discordia assalita».
blocks.translation: Tell me why so much discord has assailed it.”

blocks.source: E quelli a me: «Dopo lunga tencione
blocks.translation: And he to me: “They, after long contention,

blocks.source: verranno al sangue, e la parte selvaggia
blocks.translation: Will come to bloodshed; and the rustic party

blocks.source: caccerà l’altra con molta offensione.
blocks.translation: Will drive the other out with much offence.

blocks.source: Poi appresso convien che questa caggia
blocks.translation: Then afterwards behoves it this one fall

blocks.source: infra tre soli, e che l’altra sormonti
blocks.translation: Within three suns, and rise again the other

blocks.source: con la forza di tal che testé piaggia.
blocks.translation: With the aid of one who now plays both sides.

blocks.source: Alte terrà lungo tempo le fronti,
blocks.translation: High will it hold its forehead a long while,

blocks.source: tenendo l’altra sotto gravi pesi,
blocks.translation: Keeping the other under heavy burdens,

blocks.source: come che di ciò pianga o che n’aonti.
blocks.translation: Howe’er it weeps thereat and is indignant.

blocks.source: Giusti son due, e non vi sono intesi;
blocks.translation: The just are two, and are not understood there;

blocks.source: superbia, invidia e avarizia sono
blocks.translation: Envy and Arrogance and Avarice

blocks.source: le tre faville c’hanno i cuori accesi».
blocks.translation: Are the three sparks that have all hearts enkindled.”

blocks.source: Qui puose fine al lagrimabil suono.
blocks.translation: Here ended he his tearful utterance;

blocks.source: E io a lui: «Ancor vo’ che mi ’nsegni
blocks.translation: And I to him: “I wish thee still to teach me,

blocks.source: e che di più parlar mi facci dono.
blocks.translation: And make a gift to me of further speech.

blocks.source: Farinata e ’l Tegghiaio, che fuor sì degni,
blocks.translation: Farinata and Tegghiaio, once so worthy,

blocks.source: Iacopo Rusticucci, Arrigo e ’l Mosca
blocks.translation: Jacopo Rusticucci, Arrigo, and Mosca,

blocks.source: e li altri ch’a ben far puoser li ’ngegni,
blocks.translation: And others who on good deeds set their thoughts,

blocks.source: dimmi ove sono e fa ch’io li conosca;
blocks.translation: Say where they are, and cause that I may know them;

blocks.source: ché gran disio mi stringe di savere
blocks.translation: For great desire constraineth me to learn

blocks.source: se ’l ciel li addolcia o lo ’nferno li attosca».
blocks.translation: If Heaven doth sweeten them, or Hell envenom.”

blocks.source: E quelli: «Ei son tra l’anime più nere;
blocks.translation: And he: “They are among the blacker souls;

blocks.source: diverse colpe giù li grava al fondo:
blocks.translation: A different sin downweighs them to the bottom;

blocks.source: se tanto scendi, là i potrai vedere.
blocks.translation: If thou so far descendest, thou canst see them.

blocks.source: Ma quando tu sarai nel dolce mondo,
blocks.translation: But when thou art again in the sweet world,

blocks.source: priegoti ch’a la mente altrui mi rechi:
blocks.translation: I pray thee to the mind of others bring me;

blocks.source: più non ti dico e più non ti rispondo».
blocks.translation: No more I tell thee and no more I answer.”

blocks.source: Li diritti occhi torse allora in biechi;
blocks.translation: Then his straightforward eyes he turned askance,

blocks.source: guardommi un poco e poi chinò la testa:
blocks.translation: Eyed me a little, and then bowed his head;

blocks.source: cadde con essa a par de li altri ciechi.
blocks.translation: He fell therewith prone like the other blind.

blocks.source: E ’l duca disse a me: «Più non si desta
blocks.translation: And the Guide said to me: “He wakes no more

blocks.source: di qua dal suon de l’angelica tromba,
blocks.translation: This side the sound of the angelic trumpet;

blocks.source: quando verrà la nimica podesta:
blocks.translation: When shall approach the hostile Potentate,

blocks.source: ciascun rivederà la trista tomba,
blocks.translation: Each one shall find again his dismal tomb,

blocks.source: ripiglierà sua carne e sua figura,
blocks.translation: Shall reassume his flesh and his own figure,

blocks.source: udirà quel ch’in etterno rimbomba».
blocks.translation: Shall hear what through eternity re-echoes.”

blocks.source: Sì trapassammo per sozza mistura
blocks.translation: So we passed onward o’er the filthy mixture

blocks.source: de l’ombre e de la pioggia, a passi lenti,
blocks.translation: Of shadows and of rain with footsteps slow,

blocks.source: toccando un poco la vita futura;
blocks.translation: Touching a little on the future life.

blocks.source: per ch’io dissi: «Maestro, esti tormenti
blocks.translation: Wherefore I said: “Master, these torments here,

blocks.source: crescerann’ ei dopo la gran sentenza,
blocks.translation: Will they increase after the mighty sentence,

blocks.source: o fier minori, o saran sì cocenti?».
blocks.translation: Or lesser be, or will they be as burning?”

blocks.source: Ed elli a me: «Ritorna a tua scïenza,
blocks.translation: And he to me: “Return unto thy science,

blocks.source: che vuol, quanto la cosa è più perfetta,
blocks.translation: Which wills, that as the thing more perfect is,

blocks.source: più senta il bene, e così la doglienza.
blocks.translation: The more it feels of pleasure and of pain.

blocks.source: Tutto che questa gente maladetta
blocks.translation: Albeit that this people maledict

blocks.source: in vera perfezion già mai non vada,
blocks.translation: To true perfection never can attain,

blocks.source: di là più che di qua essere aspetta».
blocks.translation: Hereafter more than now they look to be.”

blocks.source: Noi aggirammo a tondo quella strada,
blocks.translation: Round in a circle by that road we went,

blocks.source: parlando più assai ch’i’ non ridico;
blocks.translation: Speaking much more, which I do not repeat;

blocks.source: venimmo al punto dove si digrada:
blocks.translation: We came unto the point where the descent is;

blocks.source: quivi trovammo Pluto, il gran nemico.
blocks.translation: There we found Plutus the great enemy.
